name: Hilkiah
role: High priest who found the Book of the Law
whenBasis: The reign as the Reign tab dates it, from Thiele's reconstruction of the kings' stated lengths and synchronisms; the other readings there differ by a few years.
summary: High priest in Josiah's reign. While the temple was being repaired with money from the offering box, he found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD and gave it to Shaphan the scribe, who read it to the king. He led the delegation to Huldah the prophetess, and removed the objects made for Baal, Asherah and the host of heaven from the temple.
body: His line runs through the high priests of the exile: Ezra is named as his descendant. The father of Jeremiah, also named Hilkiah, was a priest of Anathoth, and is not the same man.

moments.text: “I have found the Book of the Law”
